Jerry is rolling a ten-sided die. How much more likely is it (expressed as a percentage) that he rolls a number greater than 7 than that he rolls two even numbers in a row?

Will buys 20 oranges. When he gets home, he asks his 2 sons to wash as many oranges as they are years old. The oldest son is 6 years old, the youngest is half as old as the oldest. How many oranges are left unwashed?
Geb is 15 less than half the age of Haley. If Haley is 40 years old, how old is Geb?
Duncan's age seven years ago was three times Adam's age five years ago. If Duncan's age is 70 now, how old will Adam be in 7 years?

Jordan wanted to surprise her mom with a homemade birthday cake. From reading the instructions, she knew it would take 25 minutes to make the cake batter and 35 minutes to bake the cake. The cake would require 3 hours to cool and an additional 15 minutes to frost the cake. If she plans to make the cake all on the same day, what is the latest time of day that Jordan can start making the cake to be ready to serve it at 6:00 pm?
Seth is twice as old as Brooke. In 3 years, the sum of their ages will be 36. How old is Seth?
In 5 days, Sofie will walk twice as far as Brian. If Sofie plans to walk 12 miles every day, how many miles will Brian walk in five days?

A train travels between 3 different cities.  It goes 60 miles from the first city to the second city, 120 miles from the second city to the third city, and 40 miles less than that combined distance to go from the third city to the first city.  It does this trip 3 times a day.  The train needs service every 19,200 miles so how many days does it go between services?

Andrew bakes 150 mini cinnamon rolls and 250 mini blueberry muffins. A normal cinnamon roll has 500 calories and a normal blueberry muffin has 400 calories. If a mini pastry has 1/4th of the calories of a normal version, how many calories do the pastries he baked have?

Arnold, Madeline, Camden, and Sarah painted 80 easter eggs. Arnold and Madeline painted the same number of eggs. Camden and Sarah painted a total of 50 eggs, but Camden painted 20 more than Sarah. How many more eggs did Camden paint than Arnold?

Fireman Frank has 300 shoes. If he gets 6 pairs of shoes on Monday and gains 20 new pairs on Wednesday and 40 pairs on Friday, how many shoes will he have on Sunday if he gets rid of 240 shoes on Saturday?

Ara joined the school basketball team five years ago. She has been playing 50 games every year. If her score for every game is 25 points, calculate the total number of points she has scored in the five years.

Chris has a two-speed lawn mower. He can mow his entire lawn in "turtle" mode in 2 hours, or 80 minutes in "rabbit" mode. Today, he experimented by mowing half in turtle mode and half in rabbit mode. How many minutes did it take him to mow the lawn?

The basketball team went to the steakhouse to eat dinner.  The first player ate a 9-ounce steak.  The second player ate beef tips, containing 6 beef tips, each an ounce in size.  The third player ate a one-pound steak.  And the fourth and fifth players ordered vegetarian meals.  In total, how many ounces of meat were consumed by the team?

Morisette and Kael were asked to bring fruits. Morisette brought 6 apples and 6 oranges, while Kael brought thrice the amount of apples and half the number of oranges than Morisette. How many fruits do they have in total?
Marin and his neighbor Nancy each eat 5 apples a day. How many apples do they eat in 25 days?

The population of porcupines in a park is 70. The number of female porcupines is 2/3 of the total population. If each female porcupine gives birth to 3 babies every month, how many porcupines will be in the park after a year?

In one year, the number of students on campus doubles at the end of every month. If there are 20 students on campus at the beginning of the year, how many additional students would have joined by the end of May, above and beyond the number of students already on campus at the beginning of the year?

John collects garbage from 4 different apartment complexes. The first three have 300 apartments each and the last one is 50% bigger than the other three combined. He collects garbage 2 times a week from each place and he gets paid $.50 per collection for each apartment. How much money does he make in a week?
John drinks a bottle of water every half hour.  A normal sudoku puzzle takes him 30 minutes.  An extreme sudoku takes 3 times that long.  How many bottles of water does he drink in that time?
John buys twice as many red ties as blue ties.  The green ties cost 70% more than yellow ties. He spent $300 on yellow ties that cost $30 each. How much did he spend on ties?
John packs M&M in small bags to eat.  He buys 5 large bags weighing 12 ounces each.  If an ounce of M&M has 20 M&M in it how many small bags can he make if he puts 15 in each small bag?

Greg has an alarm set to ring three times a day as a reminder. When the alarm goes off, it continues to ring until Greg turns it off. The first time it went off today, it rang five times. The second time it went off, it rang for two times as long as the first time. The third time, it rang for half as long as the second time. How many times did the alarm ring in all?
Mazie has 75 marbles and gives them to twins, Dallas and Darla. If Dallas has a total of 30 marbles after dropping 5 of them in the playground, how many did Mazie give to Darla?

Jason works as a salesperson at a car dealership. He needs to sell 20 cars this month to earn a big bonus. He knows based on historical averages, that for every 30 telephone calls he makes to potential customers, he gets one person to come into the car dealership to look at new cars. And for every three customers that come into the car dealership, one will buy a car. Based on these average numbers, how many telephone calls would Jason need to make to sell 20 cars and earn his bonus?
At a spa, Iris spent $500 to do her hair, 1/5 as much to do a manicure, and 2/5 as much money as a manicure to do a pedicure. How much money did she spend at the spa?
Carmen has $200, Samantha has $30 more than Carmen, and Daisy has $80 more than Samantha. How much do all three girls have combined?

Gissela, Gordy, and Gary are truck drivers.  Gissela has a truck large enough to haul 5,000 pounds of gravel. Gordy's truck can haul 600 pounds more than Gissela's truck.  And when Gary brings his truck and joins Gissela and Gordy, the three trucks combined can haul a total of 12,000 pounds of gravel. How many pounds of gravel can Gary's truck carry?
4 trees each had 9 blue birds in them. 3 different trees each had 5 blue birds. 2 final trees had 4 blue birds. How many blue birds were in the trees in total?
Tommy is fundraising for his charity by selling brownies for $5 a slice and cheesecakes for $6 a slice. If Tommy sells 35 brownies and 15 slices of cheesecake, how much money does Tommy raise?
Lani baked 60 cookies. She ate 6 cookies and placed the rest equally into nine jars. How many cookies were in each jar?
Jackie grew 4" over the summer. She is now 3" shorter than Anne, who is twice the size of Albert. If Albert is 45" tall, how tall was Jackie before summer?

A football team has 175 members. There are twice as many players on the offense as there is on the defense. There is half the number of players on the special teams as there is on the defense. How many players are on the defense?

Every day, Wendi feeds each of her chickens four cups of mixed chicken feed, containing seeds, mealworms and vegetables to help keep them healthy. She gives the chickens their feed in three separate meals. In the morning, she gives her flock of chickens 20 cups of feed. In the afternoon, she gives her chickens another 30 cups of feed. How many cups of feed does she need to give her chickens in the final meal of the day if the size of Wendi's flock is 25 chickens?

8 out of 12 cheerleaders are 56" tall.  The 10th cheerleader is 72" tall.  If they build a human pyramid, where 4 girls are on the bottom,  3 stand on top of the 4, 2 stand on top of the 3 and the shortest girl is at the top, how tall is the human pyramid in feet?

Marcell and Beatrice are having a contest to see who can eat the most fruit roll-ups, so they unroll as many as they can find. Unfortunately, someone makes a mistake and Beatrice's was two roll-ups wide and 30 rolls up long while Marcell's was 4 roll-ups wide and 20 roll-ups long. If they both ate their entire amount, how many did they eat on average?

Theo has $8000 he wishes to spend on his upcoming business trip to South Africa. He buys 8 business suits at $150 each, 4 suitcases at $75 each, a flight ticket that costs $900 more than 6 times as much as the cost of a business suit. He wishes to save $2500 for this trip, how much does he have to spend on buying gifts for his business partners in South Africa?

Samwell owns an appliances store. For this week, one-third of their sales are smart TVs, one-sixth are analog TVs, and the rest are OLED TVs. If they were able to sell a total of 60 TVs, how many OLED TVs were they able to sell?
Jon's car needs a tune-up every 2000 miles. He drives 200 miles a day for a 20 day month. How many tune-ups does he need in that time?

Adam really wants to ride the biggest roller coaster at the park. The height requirement for this ride is 5 feet. Adam's height is 50 inches and he grows 4 inches every year. How many years until he is tall enough to ride it?
Joseph had 4 times as many notebooks as Martha. Martha decided she needed more notebooks and then bought 6 more for a total of 8 notebooks. How many more than Joseph does she now have?

Tanya makes a salt scrub from salt, oil, fragrance, citrus zest, and sugar. She makes enough to fill a 20-ounce jar each time. She uses the same amount of citrus zest as fragrance and the same amount of salt as sugar. She uses twice as much oil as salt and twice as much salt as zest. How many ounces of oil does she use?
Shiela is required to submit a 30-page research paper. She already finished writing 1/2 of the paper. How many pages does she have left to write?

Ali is a dean of a private school where he teaches one class. John is also a dean of a public school. John has two classes in his school. Each class has 1/6 the capacity of Ali’s class which has the capacity of 150 students. What is the combined capacity of both schools?
Shondra has 5 fewer plants than Toni. Toni has 80% more plants than Frederick. If Frederick has 15 plants, how many plants does Shondra have?

Sheila charged $95.00 worth of merchandise on her credit card.  She ended up returning one item that cost $15.00.  After she returned the item, she bought a frying pan that was on sale for 20% off $20.00 and a set of towels that was 10% off $30.00.  She put both of these purchases on her credit card.  What is the new balance on her credit card?

Greg puts clean sheets on 3 twin beds and 2 king size bed every week.  His laundry machine will only allow him to wash 3 twin sets of sheets at a time and 1 king set of sheets at a time.  How many loads of laundry does he do in a year?
Two girls each got 1/4 of the 32 liters of water. Then a boy got 8 liters of water. How many liters of water were left?

A $3000 watch was put on sale so that Mr. Johnson bought it at 80% of its original price. He then sold the watch to his colleague at 130% of the price that he bought it. What is the percentage discount obtained by Mr. Johnson's colleague from the original price?

When Billy was first hired, he was paid at a rate of $15 per hour.  After 5 months, he was given a raise of $0.80 per hour.  On his first anniversary at work, he was given a raise of $1.00 per hour.  Sally just started working at a different business, and her starting salary is $0.50 more per hour than Billy's starting salary was.  If both Billy and Sally work 30 hours, how much more money will Billy earn than Sally, in dollars?
There are 12 quarts of tea left from the party. Five students each drank 1.2 quarts of tea and 18 students each drank 3 quarts of tea. How many gallons of tea were at the beginning of the party?

Bubbles collects stuffed animals. She has four stuffed puppies, seven stuffed koalas, three stuffed zebras and six stuffed frogs. If she wants to buy enough stuffed goats, such that the percentage of stuffed goats is 40% of all of her stuffed animals, how many stuffed goats should she buy?

Kim has started his own housekeeping business and is calculating how much profit he will make from his clients. He already has 4 clients, but is talking to another 6 potential clients and feels confident enough to include them in his calculations. Each client’s home will need 3 bottles of bleach and a pack of cloths to clean. Bottles of bleach will cost $1 each and packs of cloths will cost $4 each. These are his only expenses. He calculates that his total income each week will be $95. Profit is the difference between total income and total expenses, so how much profit, in dollars, will Lucas make each week?
Argo has 300 toys. He gives 50 toys to Alyssa, 60 to Bonnie, and 50 to Nicky. How many toys does Argo have now?
Jennifer's dog has 9 puppies, 6 of which have spots. Brandon's dog has 15 puppies, 6 of which have spots. What percentage of all the puppies have spots?

Jonathan was sad to learn he needed 3 more toys than he already had to have enough toys to make a sorted play set four times larger than James's play set, which had 60 toys. How many toys does Jonathan currently have?

A pound of almonds costs $24 while a pound of walnuts costs $12. How much more does it cost for a mixture of 2/3 pound almonds and 1/2 pound walnuts than a mixture of 1/4 pound almonds and 1/2 pound walnuts?
A tub of ice cream costing $15 is now sold at $12. A packet of milk was sold at a discount of $0.7. How much will you save if you buy 3 tubs of ice cream and 5 packets of milk?

Sunny is selling gingerbread and apple pie for a fundraiser. On Saturday, he sold 15 boxes of gingerbread and 3 fewer boxes of apple pie, than on Sunday. On Sunday, he sold 7 more boxes of gingerbread than on Saturday and 20 boxes of apple pie. If the gingerbread cost $8 and the apple pie cost $18, how much did Sunny earn for two days?

Olivia uploaded 90 pictures to Facebook. She put the same number of the pics into 9 albums. 4 of the albums were selfies only and 3 of the albums were portraits. How many portraits and selfies did she have?
